newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's NBP bond rated AAA by local agency.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's NBP bond rated AAA by local agency.

text.p: The state-run National Bank of Pakistan (NBP) received an AAA rating on Wednesday from Pakistan's only credit rating agency for its proposed bond issue worth one billion rupees ($24.9 million).
The Pakistan Credit Rating Agency Ltd (PACRA) said it had assigned its highest rating to the NBP's issue of Term Finance Certificates (TFCs).

It said it had "taken into account that repayment of principal and expected profit on the TFCs (is) secured by a designated pool of liquid government securities with the authority vested in the trustees to encash these in the event of any contingency".
The triple-A rating signifies lowest risk on investment and substantial capacity for timely redemption of principal and payment of interest.
NBP officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
